steps.content: Several days ago, the Bureau

Dear Chief:

　　It has been far too long since we last spoke, and you have been much in my thoughts.
　　However, I write today not to reminisce, but to inform you of an urgent matter.
　　Ever since Nightfall, Northwild has remained a persistent concern for Eastia. The region has been without a seer for thirty years, leaving disasters unchecked in this mountainous, isolated terrain. <color=#fb9259>In recent years, we frequently detect signs of Sinner activity in the area</color>—on a scale rarely seen elsewhere in Eastia. Yet even envoys from the alliance cannot intervene rashly without proper cause, lest we provoke local resistance or further strain the already fragile relationships between Eastian cities in these post-Nightfall times. Thus, we have been limited to observation alone.
　　Fortunately, thanks to the trust we have built through our previous collaborations, DisCity has offered to deploy operatives for covert investigation upon learning of Eastia's predicament. Details are attached in this letter, and Schorl can provide additional clarification.
　　This matter is of utmost importance, so please handle it with caution. This brief letter cannot contain my deepest thoughts about you, so I can only wish you success and safety in all your endeavors.

Warmest regards,
Du Ruo

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: "DisCity has offered to deploy operatives for covert investigation..."
You click your tongue and glance sideways at Schorl, who's waiting for you to finish reading.

options: What have you guys discovered about Northwild?

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: I'm pleased you've identified the key issue. The matter requiring your attention isn't actually the letter itself. Something that's currently both closely tied to Sinners and under heavy scrutiny—I'm sure you've already guessed what that might be, Chief.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: My guess isn't proof. Give me something concrete.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: As you suspect, we initially paid little attention when we received the letter from Envoy Du Ruo. That changed when DisCity's contacts in the farlands reported back: <color=#fb9259>Fraser is involved in Aurum Secretum smuggling, and Eastia's Northwild is one of the buyers</color>. Moreover, these transactions have been going on for several years.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: We attempted to trace the activity, but the Aurum Secretum trail vanished once it entered Northwild. Combined with the region's isolationist governance and underdeveloped infrastructure, our operatives couldn't function effectively.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Something that required such elaborate effort to transport couldn't simply disappear. Most likely it's been converted into another form and put to use.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: This actually provides a breakthrough for our investigation, because the key difference between Aurum Secretum Tech and Hypercubes is that only Sinners with the compatible type of Mania can harness it. That group of Sinners who have suddenly emerged in Northwild are obviously prime suspects.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Eastia is probably only interested in those Sinners because they are looking for new seers. Why should we be investigating this?

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: That's not something you need to concern yourself with, Chief. All you need to focus on is <color=#fb9259>tracking the Aurum Secretum trade</color>.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Judging by how insistent Du Ruo sounds in that letter, I'm guessing you're sending me on this investigation? Finally another field assignment to the Outlands, and you're not giving me the full briefing?

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: We chose you because Eastia trusts you. No other agents can act with the degree of freedom you have in Eastia, making it easier for DisCity to look for the answers it's after under the guise of this joint investigation.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: If you must know more, then know that an isolated valley chronically dependent on Aurum Secretum naturally raises suspicions for DisCity. Aurum Secretum isn't just an inferior substitute for Hypercubes. It's a critical link between <color=#fb9259>the Underground and the farlands</color>.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: We trust the Eastian Alliance more than the farlands, but that doesn't mean we can lower our guard against potential threats under the current circumstances.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: I appreciate your sense of humor.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: A recent rumor in Northwild is drawing many Sinners toward Northsnow Manor. This provides us with an excellent opportunity for our investigation. The convoy is standing by outside the Bureau, but there's some information you need to know before we depart.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: In Northwild, Sinners are commonly referred to as <color=#fb9259>"martial heroes"</color>, a term rooted in the martial arts culture that has flourished in Eastia since ancient times. To help you blend in during this operation, we've arranged a corresponding identity for you as well.
"Sandsnow Wanderer" ${PlayerName}, a lone rider wandering the world covered in Eastian snow and DisCity sand.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Are you planning to stay bundled up the entire time we're in Northwild?

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Unstable... signals... This Sinner gathering in Northwild... happened too suddenly... Didn't have time to adapt equipment... for low temperature environment...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Um, why do you keep cutting out?

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Underdeveloped infrastructure... Eastia has signal bases... outside Northwild... but clearly... coverage is poor...

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Don't worry... I'll keep communications brief... if you need backup... support is standing by... outside Northwild...
You whisper cautiously to Schorl while casually leaning against the inn's counter. Whenever someone passes by, you whistle a tune and pretend to mutter to yourself.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Please don't tell me you're running low on battery. I don't think I can find a way to charge you here.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Rest easy... I'm on power saving mode... Besides... even without me... you're handling things well... When everyone was staring earlier... you quickly changed the subject... distracting them...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: How was I supposed to know this place would be so cut off that you don't even have map data?
Seeing the attendant approaching the counter with hot water, you quickly press Schorl down to hide it.

Fortunately, the attendant only refills your tea before hurrying off to other tables, completely oblivious to anything unusual. The inn hasn't seen this much activity in ages, and he's already run off his feet trying to keep up.

steps.speaker: Attendant
steps.content: Here's your "Snow Soul," sir. A potent brew unique to Northwild, distilled from water of three-year-old snow from Mount Fuyun. Only one jar is made each year. I hope you enjoy it.

steps.speaker: Shen Wanchou
steps.content: Mm... what a fierce flavor. Indeed a priceless treasure. My silver was well spent. I've heard that drinking this while circulating one's inner energy can even calm restless Qi. Mount Fuyun really is an excellent place for cultivating one's spiritual essence.

steps.speaker: Ji Guining
steps.content: Young master, those claims about "enhancing one's cultivation" were proven to be mere merchant tales long ago. The heroes of Northwild are valued for their benevolent hearts and moral conduct, for earning the common people's trust and respect. No expensive liquor can get you those things, though "Snow Soul" is indeed a fine brew. You do have excellent taste.

Based on your limited pre-mission intel and what you've learned from the town's storyteller, you've pieced together the context. The "martial heroes" and "seers" here indeed share the same origin, both drawing power from the collective will of the people. But while seers rely on divine oracles, martial heroes focus on doing good deeds.
But this "cultivation" they speak of... You continue listening.

steps.speaker: Shen Wanchou
steps.content: I didn't expect you to be such a connoisseur of fine spirits as well, Lady Ji. Martial principles can indeed be found in cups of wine. I see we're like-minded in this aspect. Perhaps you and I could exchange a few moves when we're free? I'd gladly wager a bottle of my finest western Crimson Flame.

steps.speaker: Ma Ling
steps.content: Ha! Already itching for action before we even reach the mountain? Perfect! This inn's got plenty of space. Hey, egghead! I've long heard about those silver needles of yours, how they can save lives and take down enemies. After we've eaten our fill, how about you and I have a little sparring match? I'd love to see what you can do!

steps.speaker: Xu Shen
steps.content: You flatter me, General. Your halberd swept away all the bandits in the northern mountains. Now that's true martial skill. I'd be pleased to receive guidance from you.

steps.speaker: Yin Yansheng
steps.content: Ah, how wonderful... You younglings have such composed auras, and I can see a glow of vitality in your eyes. Seeing such vigor in you all makes this old man feel rejuvenated.

steps.speaker: Jiewubei
steps.content: Old Yin! Quit showing off with all that fancy talk! Why don't you take a look at me too? Lately my body's been stuck going in circles at the third stage of "Vajra Exorcism," and it's driving me crazy!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Stagnant cultivation... Has his special power reached its limit?
The Immortal Healer's brow furrows with concern.

steps.speaker: Yin Yansheng
steps.content: Wubei... Why is your Qi and blood surging like boiling water? Your yang energy is overflowing and seems to be clashing with this mountain's coldness... You must be extremely careful these days. Don't force yourself too much!

steps.speaker: Jiewubei
steps.content: Bah, nonsense! Tonight I'm going to devour every last bit of this coldness. Let's see what's tougher, this blizzard or my bones!
Without any warning, Jiewubei slams the table and shoots to his feet, launching a palm strike directly at the Immortal Healer sitting beside him.
Surprisingly, the Healer shows no anger and begins sparring with him in earnest.
As you quietly marvel at the wild customs of this place, the eager general also spins around and throws herself into the fray.

Hands swish through sizzling breath while blades tear through the frigid air. Their figures crisscross in wide, sweeping movements, the shockwaves from their techniques shaking dust from the rafters above. Their physiques and speed have indeed far exceeded the bounds of ordinary humans.
You duck behind the counter for cover and gently tap Schorl in your arms.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Their speed, strength, resilience, and weapon proficiency all match the enhancement patterns of Mania corruption on humans. They all appear to be at least A-Class Sinners. Looks like we've already run into our targets before we even reach Northsnow Manor.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Their power is somewhat different from DisCity Sinners... I can't quite put my finger on it, but it feels purer and more unified. Perhaps this is the "internal force" mentioned in the materials you gave me? My shackles aren't picking up any corruption fluctuations for now. Have you noticed anything special?
Schorl is completely unresponsive.
This time it clearly makes an effort, but after struggling against your chest and emitting some electrical crackling noise, it gives out completely.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Tch... Thanks for nothing, I guess.
Everyone in the inn has their eyes glued to this rare confrontation, making your hunched figure whispering by the counter all the more conspicuous.
Just as you're about to discreetly give that metallic bump in your arms a proper shake, a gentle yet clear voice drifts near unhurriedly.

steps.speaker: Ji Guining
steps.content: You carry yourself with such composure, young friend... You don't seem like an ordinary spectator. Could it be that... you're one of us?
She's asking whether you're also a "martial hero" who possesses the special powers unique to Northwild. You immediately become alert.
But the more you turn your head away, the more the Princess pushes her wheelchair closer out of curiosity.

If these people are indeed your targets for this mission, you'll inevitably have to deal with them once you reach the manor. No point in being evasive now. You offer a slight smile and nod in acknowledgment.

steps.speaker: Ji Guining
steps.content: I don't think I recognize you, young hero. Where do you hail from? Under which renowned peak did you train?
She's asking about your background and territorial affiliations.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: The world is my home, and I come from wherever I came.

steps.speaker: Ji Guining
steps.content: I do hear a foreign accent.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I've lost my hometown accent after wandering for so long.

steps.speaker: Ji Guining
steps.content: That's a fine sword. You must be quite accomplished in the way of the blade?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I only know the basics. Compared to all of you, my skills are nothing.

steps.speaker: Ji Guining
steps.content: The people sitting in this room would send ordinary wanderers of the martial world fleeing in terror. Yet you remain completely unperturbed... Such composure is rarely seen in a novice.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: But I am indeed a novice, and that's why I don't recognize any of you by name. I can only tell that you are all extraordinary individuals. I'm used to traveling alone and am not bound by these formalities. Please excuse my discourtesy.

You maintain your composure and handle the situation smoothly, though you can't help but grumble internally about the Eastians' roundabout ways of speaking and their many rules... Thank goodness you had Yugu give you a crash course before departure.
Of course, I did. If the Paradeisian official wasn't there, why should I care if they were dead or alive?

steps.speaker: Xu Shen
steps.content: If I remember correctly, when you first entered, didn't you say... you were heading to Northsnow Manor?

steps.speaker: Xu Shen
steps.content: That's exactly our destination as well. This meeting must be fate. May I ask your epithet?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: ...Ahem, Sandsnow Wanderer, ${PlayerName}.
Saying it out loud makes you feel inexplicably embarrassed, but to your surprise, two of them actually applaud and cheer.

steps.speaker: Shen Wanchou
steps.content: Anyone who can make it on their own in the martial world must have exceptional abilities. I love befriending young talents! I'm curious, how did someone so young manage to reach the martial arts threshold? Do tell, my new friend!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I'm just a small fry who happens to have picked up some skills while helping others on the road. I'm no expert, so there's not much to tell...

steps.speaker: Ma Ling
steps.content: It's my passion to cross blades with every swordsman I meet! It is a common weapon, so true mastery is rare. If you've chosen this sword yourself, you oughtn't conceal it. Show me what you can do!

Before you can refuse, the General has already seized her halberd and vaulted over the table's edge with one hand, swooping toward you like a sparrowhawk. The red tassel on her weapon flutters as she strikes directly at the sword sheath in your hand.
While your answers have been flawless, actual combat will inevitably expose you. If you activate your shackles here, everything—the manor gathering, the covert investigation—will be for nothing.

You dodge desperately but are still driven toward the main hall by the halberd's sweeping force. Fortunately, you've observed earlier that while the inn is large, the cluttered furnishings will limit the General's long weapon. Before you can think further, another swift strike whistles past your ear.

After dodging three consecutive strikes, you finally manage to create some distance from the General. Just as you're about to offer some praise and slip away, a scorching hot hand suddenly presses against your back.
A domineering surge of energy lands on your back, probing your internal circulation.

steps.speaker: Jiewubei
steps.content: I thought you were some hidden master, but you don't even know where your Qihai point is! Which clan are you from? They think they can just send a lamb into a wolf den?!

This man clearly isn't one to listen to explanations. You desperately want to escape, but just as you start to move, the Immortal Healer, who has been silently observing, strikes his walking stick against the ground. The soft tap somehow sounds thunderous, perfectly blocking your path.

steps.speaker: Yin Yansheng
steps.content: Your Qihai is weak, your foundation shaky... This old man can see you're no true martial hero. Heroes and ordinary folk are two different species. Young friend, you've risked great danger posing as one of us. What are you plotting... Would you care to enlighten this old man?
The moment these words leave his lips, Jiewubei's palm crashes down like raging torrents, giving you no time to defend yourself.
